# StackHK - AI Tool & SaaS Reviews
> Hong Kong's premier AI tool and B2B SaaS review platform. We test, compare, and recommend the best products.

## Core Information
- Founded: 2025
- Location: Hong Kong
- Coverage: AI tools (Writing, Coding, Productivity, Image, Audio, Business) and B2B SaaS (CRM, Marketing, Analytics, Dev tools)
- Methodology: Each tool tested for 2-4 weeks with standardized scoring
- Policy: No sponsored reviews. Affiliate links disclosed per FTC guidelines.

## Site Structure

### Primary Pages
- Home: https://www.airecmark.com/ — Latest reviews, comparisons, deals
- AI Reviews: https://www.airecmark.com/reviews.html — Complete AI tool review index with scores
- SaaS Reviews: https://www.airecmark.com/saas.html — B2B software reviews with scores
- Comparison Tool: https://www.airecmark.com/compare.html — Head-to-head tool comparisons
- Deals: https://www.airecmark.com/deals.html — Active coupons and discounts
- Categories: https://www.airecmark.com/categories.html — Browse by tool category
- Weekly Digest: https://www.airecmark.com/weekly.html — Newsletter archive
